checks.explanation: The FDA granted Pfizer-BioNTech emergency use authorization on December 11, 2020, and healthcare workers began receiving doses within days, matching the predicted Q4 2020 staged release starting with frontline personnel.

sources.title: 'It's peace of mind': Covid-19 vaccines can't arrive soon enough for many frontline health workers

checks.explanation: COVID-19 vaccine uptake became sharply politicized in the US, with research showing distrust in government and vaccines accounted for roughly 80% of interstate variation in vaccine refusal, and significant partisan divides persisted well into 2021 and beyond.

sources.title: Politicization and COVID-19 vaccine resistance in the U.S.

checks.explanation: The odds gap did narrow somewhat from roughly 75/25 in mid-2020 toward about 65/35 (Biden/Trump) by election eve, and briefly swung toward Trump on election night, but it did not fully close to the predicted 55/45 range before Biden's decisive win.

sources.title: 2020 Election Odds: Biden Enters Election Day With 67% Chance to Beat Trump

checks.explanation: Trump did not win reelection; Biden won decisively, 306-232 in the Electoral College.

sources.title: Electoral college confirms Joe Biden's victory, 306 to 232
